name: list
title: List
description: Vertical sequence primitive — semantic <ul>/<ol> with Lumen chrome. Three flavors: plain (text bullets / numbered), structured (each row is a ListItem with leading/trailing slots, the Apple Settings / iOS-style listview), and interactive (each row navigates or actions, with hover + focus chrome). Pairs with Divider for inset separators; with Skeleton[shape='row'] for loading state.
